_readme: Builds the open searches must find or beat (raidsim/search_check.py): known positives, each found once and missed by an earlier search. `allocation` is a flat {talent: ranks}; `build` names a build in the class's proposed-builds.json instead (repairs follow it). kind raid: entry = the specs.json entry (its rotation, full raid); kind leveling: rotation = the fight-lab spec.

positives.name: Summon Hawk + Lone Wolf melee hunter (16/11/24)
positives.found: by hand from the user's Summon Hawk build, 2026-10-03; 1118 vs 1040 DPS for the Survival pick on b0f0df3
positives.missed_by: deep_opt.py (family rule) and the first two open searches (random builds drawn only near the starts; a raw keystone seed dropped before tuning)

positives.name: the community's Arms build (Mortal Strike behind Sweeping Strikes)
positives.found: talentsforever.com popular builds, 2026-10-01; +13.7% over our Arms build in a full raid
positives.missed_by: every simulator search before prerequisite-chain moves (Mortal Strike requires Sweeping Strikes, worth ~1% alone)

positives.name: melee hunter with a pet (17/10/24)
positives.found: the first open leveling search, 2026-10-04; 24.45 vs 26.24 s per kill (20-60) for the Lone Wolf melee leveling build
positives.missed_by: the second (seeded) open leveling search, 2026-10-05 (found only a 7/14/30 at 25.68 s)
